snippet.title: Colorbound trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

Colorbound developed by Panpipe Studio and published by @WhitethornGames comes out this year!

Colorbound in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/colorbound/
Colorbound on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778610/Colorbound/
Colorbound on Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/p/colorbound-1c5e30?lang=en-US

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
